precedence: For Predictor workflow invariants, this executable policy controls over conflicting markdown summaries. Markdown remains human-readable documentation.

workflow.SXF-WF-001: Stages run in order STAGE1 -> STAGE2 -> STAGE3.
workflow.SXF-WF-002: STAGE2 and STAGE3 require explicit user authorization.
workflow.SXF-WF-003: A stage may not emit fields reserved for a later stage.
workflow.SXF-WF-004: Every user-visible match row must contain one concrete preference; screened-out Stage 1 fixtures are not user-visible prediction rows.

stage1.SXF-S1-001: Use SmartXFlow primary/production stored data only; external football research is forbidden.
stage1.SXF-S1-002: User date/time/named-match criteria define the source universe. Stage 1 must screen every valid fixture in that universe internally.
stage1.SXF-S1-003: Stage 1 user-facing output contains only attention-worthy candidates selected from the screened universe; it must not dump every scanned fixture merely because it was in the source universe.
stage1.SXF-S1-004: Every reported Stage 1 candidate must have a frozen native SXF preference with a concrete market and selection.
stage1.SXF-S1-005: Stage 1 native evidence markets are limited to 1X2, O/U 2.5 and BTTS.
stage1.SXF-S1-006: Stage 1 must inspect the available temporal path, including money, share, money velocity, odds path, price response/resistance, liquidity, reversals, momentum, late moves and native cross-market behavior.
stage1.SXF-S1-007: Stage 1 may rank/select candidates by analytical value, unusual movement, strength, divergence, persistence, acceleration or other defensible SXF behavior; screening is an analytical selection step, not an invented eligibility filter.
stage1.SXF-S1-008: Stage 1 may not issue BET, WATCH or PASS.
stage1.SXF-S1-009: The exact reported Stage 1 candidate set becomes the default carry-forward set for Stage 2 and Stage 3 unless the user changes it.

stage2.SXF-S2-001: Stage 2 starts only after explicit user authorization.
stage2.SXF-S2-002: Carry the exact Stage 1 candidate set forward unless the user changes it.
stage2.SXF-S2-003: Frozen Stage 1 preference is immutable and must remain separate from research conclusions.
stage2.SXF-S2-004: Default maximum is 6 meaningful research facts per match.
stage2.SXF-S2-005: Each match requires strongest support, strongest counter-case and research coverage classification.
stage2.SXF-S2-006: Missing/low-coverage information is UNKNOWN, not adverse evidence and creates no automatic confidence penalty.
stage2.SXF-S2-007: Stage 2 may not issue BET, WATCH or PASS.
stage2.SXF-S2-008: Claim-level evidence must keep opposite-direction facts separate and distinguish FACT from INFERENCE.

stage3.SXF-S3-001: Stage 3 starts only after explicit user authorization.
stage3.SXF-S3-002: Determine the underlying thesis before choosing the execution market.
stage3.SXF-S3-003: Strongest counterevidence severity must be scored and deducted from raw confidence.
stage3.SXF-S3-004: Joint divergence state must use price, share, absolute money, liquidity, cross-market and market-regime context; closing price alone is not a veto.
stage3.SXF-S3-005: Any non-native execution change must be labeled PROTECTION or AGGRESSION.
stage3.SXF-S3-007: Every carried match receives quality grade before action.
stage3.SXF-S3-008: Grade mapping is mandatory: A+ and A -> BET, B -> WATCH, C -> PASS.
stage3.SXF-S3-009: High confidence cannot override the quality-grade action gate.
stage3.SXF-S3-010: Every Stage 3 row retains one concrete best-current preference even when action is PASS.

execution_price.SXF-PRICE-001: Never invent or mathematically synthesize an exact non-native execution price.
execution_price.SXF-PRICE-002: A user may supply a real current non-native execution price. Store it as origin USER_SUPPLIED with exact market, exact selection, numeric price and observed_at equal to explicit user observation time when provided, otherwise message receipt time.
execution_price.SXF-PRICE-003: USER_SUPPLIED is valid observed price evidence and does not require independent web verification, but the agent may not alter, round into another price, transfer it to another market/selection or silently refresh it.
execution_price.SXF-PRICE-004: Ambiguous/stale user-supplied prices must be marked stale/needs-confirmation or converted to a conditional threshold; never pretend they are current.
execution_price.SXF-PRICE-005: A threshold is not actual odds. A priced formal non-native BET requires an actual observed price from EXTERNAL_VERIFIED or USER_SUPPLIED.

archive.SXF-ARCH-001: Normal formal Learning Archive cases are BET or WATCH only; PASS is not a fake formal case.
archive.SXF-ARCH-002: prediction_at is the immutable PRE/POST cutoff and may not be backdated.
archive.SXF-ARCH-003: Historical prediction/evidence truth is append-only; silent rewriting is forbidden.

performance_comparison.SXF-PERF-001: For every settled Stage 1 candidate, preserve and grade the frozen Stage 1 preference as a baseline even when Stage 3 changes the market/selection or action becomes PASS.
performance_comparison.SXF-PERF-002: For every settled carried match, separately grade the final Stage 3 best-current preference hypothetically, independent of whether action was BET, WATCH or PASS.
performance_comparison.SXF-PERF-003: Report Stage 1 baseline vs Stage 3 final preference hit-rate on the same matched case set, plus changed/unchanged preference counts and IMPROVED/WORSENED/SAME transitions.
performance_comparison.SXF-PERF-004: Where actual observed prices exist, also compare one-unit hypothetical ROI for Stage 1 baseline and Stage 3 final preference. Never fabricate missing prices.
performance_comparison.SXF-PERF-005: Treat the Stage 1 vs Stage 3 delta as evidence about whether Stage 2/context/execution changes add value; do not claim benefit from anecdotes or unmatched samples.
